_readme: Source list for the Student Gallery on students.html. Edit this file, then run: node build-student-gallery.js "<folder with the original photos>". Order here is the order on the page. cat = online | studio | community. crop = [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the photo, used to trim Zoom / Instagram / Procreate screen UI. student = an id from data/students.json (adds a link to that student's profile). Entries with "skip" stay off the page (duplicates and near-identical shots); delete the skip key to publish one.
